ns2:course.label: Advanced Interaction Design
ns2:course.description: This advanced studio immerses students in design investigations that foster understanding of emergent digital interaction paradigms. Potential areas of exploration include design and development for both mobile devices and interactive environments. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARTD 318.
